newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fiyta 1996 net profit hits 64 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Fiyta 1996 net profit hits 64 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen Fiyta Holdings Ltd registered net profit of 64.42 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Monday.
Earnings per share were 0.465 yuan in 1996 and turnover reached 345.81 million yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
The company posted net profit of 63.97 million yuan on turnover of 346.46 million for 1995 based on international standards, according to the company's 1995 annual report.
Under Chinese standards, it registed net profit of 70.75 million yuan on turnover of 349.65 million yuan in 1995, the report said.
The firm has proposed a cash dividend of 0.1 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
The company also proposed a two-for-10 rights offer, tentatively priced at between 6.00 and 9.00 yuan per share, it said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Tuesday morning and resume in the afternoon, the statement said.
